blocks.text: PHILADELPHIA— Deni Avdija scored 31 points and hit five of Portland’s 19 3-pointers to lead the Trail Blazers to a 128-111 win over the Philadelphia 76ers in the NBA on Monday night. The Trail Blazers crushed the Sixers all game with the long ball and handed them just their fourth loss of the season.
